title: The Cage Is Working: A Self-Auditing Scoreboard of Deterministic Guard Refusals in a Self-Healing Operating System
description: Evidence record of the SQUIRL OS self-healing fleet's guard scoreboard as measured 2026-10-18: 6,714 anomalies resolved lifetime, 711 successful healing events, and 77 recorded refusals in which the system detected a condition that looked actionable and declined to heal it (38 confidence-gated, 31 threshold-blocked, 6 guard-held, plus rule-mandated holds). Zero false heals in the audit trail; 11 drift-typed catches; 33 identity-gate rejections; 28 idempotency skips. Case study: nightly cycle N11, guard correctness 8/8. This document is itself tokenized under ceremony CAGE-TOK-1 (prereg sha cd0d8f07...): its SHA-256 digest (f439f1307cf3657cce4e95b18a53678a2ae5691b191e5961cdfbebaf650265d7) rides real satoshis across a Bitcoin mainnet custody walk (tx 13ccf51f... out, tx 9856c126... back) and completes an XRPL mainnet round trip (ledgers 107754066-107754080, 20 drops). Hash-only doctrine: contents never touch any rail. Prototype software: educational and research purposes only.
